items.title: Maria Bartiromo Out at Fox News
items.summary: Fox News has parted ways with longtime anchor  Maria Bartiromo.  The journalist is no longer with Fox News Media, effective Thursday, the network said in a news release.  Bartiromo, 58, hadn’t been on Fox News or Fox Business for almost a month.

items.title: DIS Is Priced Like The Best Of Its Group. Is It?
items.summary: The market is charging a premium for Walt Disney stock, but its growth and profit metrics currently trail key rivals. Is this a bet on a magical future, or just a storybook valuation.
